<script>
(function(){
  try{
    var sha256Hex = function(input){
      var s = String(input || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      var enc = new TextEncoder().encode(s);
      return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", enc).then(function(buf){
        var u8 = new Uint8Array(buf);
        var arr = Array.prototype.slice.call(u8);
        return arr.map(function(b){
          return ("00" + b.toString(16)).slice(-2);
        }).join("");
      });
    };

    var cleanPhone = function(ph){
      if(!ph) return "";
      return ph.replace(/\D/g,"").slice(-10);
    };

    var email = (document.querySelector("input[type='email'], input[name*='email'], input[id*='email']") || {value:""}).value || "";
    var phone = (document.querySelector("input[type='tel'], input[name*='phone'], input[id*='phone']") || {value:""}).value || "";
    var fname = (document.querySelector("input[name*='first'], input[name*='name'], input[id*='first']") || {value:""}).value || "";
    var lname = (document.querySelector("input[name*='last'], input[id*='last']") || {value:""}).value || "";

    var city = (document.querySelector("input[name*='city'], input[id*='city']") || {value:""}).value || "";
    var state = (document.querySelector("input[name*='state'], input[id*='state']") || {value:""}).value || "";
    var countryEl = document.querySelector("select[name*='country'], input[name*='country']");
    var country = (countryEl && countryEl.value) ? countryEl.value : "IN";

    var leadID = null;
    try { leadID = localStorage.getItem("meta_lead_id"); } catch(e){ leadID = null; }
    if(!leadID){
      leadID = "lead_" + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2) + Date.now();
      try{ localStorage.setItem("meta_lead_id", leadID); }catch(e){}
    }

    var pEmail = email ? sha256Hex(email) : Promise.resolve("");
    var pPhone = phone ? sha256Hex(cleanPhone(phone)) : Promise.resolve("");
    var pF = fname ? sha256Hex(fname) : Promise.resolve("");
    var pL = lname ? sha256Hex(lname) : Promise.resolve("");

    Promise.all([pEmail, pPhone, pF, pL]).then(function(results){
      var em = results[0] || "";
      var ph = results[1] || "";
      var fn = results[2] || "";
      var ln = results[3] || "";

      var metaUserData = {
        event_id: leadID,
        external_id: leadID,
        em: em,
        ph: ph,
        fn: fn,
        ln: ln,
        ct: city,
        st: state,
        country: country
      };

      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'metaUserDataReady', metaUserData: metaUserData });
    }).catch(function(err){
      console && console.warn && console.warn("meta hasher error", err);
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'metaUserDataReady', metaUserData: { event_id: leadID }});
    });

  }catch(e){
    console && console.warn && console.warn("meta hasher outer error", e);
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'metaUserDataReady', metaUserData: { event_id: ("lead_" + Date.now()) }});
  }
})();
</script>

<script>

    var match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + name + '=([^;]+)'));
    return match ? match[2] : '';
  }
  var email = getCookie('useremail');
  var phone = getCookie('userphone');
  if(email || phone){
    dataLayer.push({
      event: 'metaUserDataReady',
      metaUserData: {
        em: email,
        ph: phone,

</script>

<script>
(function(){
  if (window.__piiCapture) return; window.__piiCapture = true;
  function isEmail(v){ return /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(v); }
  function phone10(v){ var d=(v||"").replace(/\D/g,""); return d.length>=10 ? d.slice(-10) : ""; }
  function ls(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k,v); }catch(e){} }
  function lg(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(k)||""; }catch(e){ return ""; } }
  document.addEventListener("input", function(e){
    var el=e.target; if(!el||!("value" in el)) return;
    var v=(el.value||"").trim(); if(!v) return;
    if(isEmail(v)) ls("user_email",v);
    else { var p=phone10(v); if(p) ls("user_phone",p); }
  }, true);
  try{ var m=location.href.match(/[?&]leadId=([^&]+)/); if(m) ls("external_id", decodeURIComponent(m[1])); }catch(e){}
  document.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    var b=e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("button, a"); if(!b) return;
    var txt=(b.innerText||"")+" "+(b.href||"");
    if(/continue|secure|checkout|\bpay\b|reserve|cashfree/i.test(txt)){
      var em=lg("user_email"),ph=lg("user_phone"),ext=lg("external_id");
      if(em||ph){ window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[]; window.dataLayer.push({event:"metaUserDataReady",metaUserData:{em:em,ph:ph,external_id:ext,country:"IN"}}); }
    }
  }, true);
})();
</script>
